entries.k: +18% ATK, +8% SPD, -20% DEF. Finish the weakest foe.
entries.v: +18% ATK, +8% SPD, -20% DEF. Habisi musuh terlemah.

entries.k: +35% DEF, 8% starting shield, -8% ATK. Stop the strongest threat.
entries.v: +35% DEF, perisai awal 8%, -8% ATK. Hadang ancaman terkuat.

entries.k: A bard takes the empty seat beside the hearth. He knows songs of the old Emberhall. Tonight, he asks for a story worth singing tomorrow.
entries.v: Penyair duduk di dekat tungku. Ia mengenal lagu tentang Emberhall lama. Malam ini, ia meminta kisah untuk dinyanyikan esok.

entries.k: A child waits by the gate with an empty basket. Her kitten ran behind the old stone wall. To her, this is the most important quest in the realm.
entries.v: Seorang anak menunggu di gerbang dengan keranjang kosong. Kucingnya lari ke balik tembok tua. Baginya, inilah misi terpenting di dunia.

entries.k: A colorful wagon rolls up to the hall. Its owner warms his hands at your hearth, then offers the supplies he saved for the next adventure.
entries.v: Kereta warna-warni tiba di aula. Pemiliknya menghangatkan tangan di tungku, lalu menawarkan bekal untuk petualangan berikutnya.

entries.k: A hooded traveler leaves a little sealed box beneath your banner. The Spire's crest sparkles on its lid. Maren smiles at the new mystery.
entries.v: Pengelana berkerudung meninggalkan kotak kecil di bawah panji. Lambang Menara berkilau di tutupnya. Maren tersenyum menyambut misteri baru.

entries.k: A new creature curls up beside the hearth. It knows paths no map can show. Maren quietly adds another bowl to the supper table.
entries.v: Makhluk baru berbaring di sisi tungku. Ia mengenal jalan yang tak ada di peta. Maren menambah satu mangkuk di meja makan.

entries.k: A noble arrives with a heavy purse and an enthusiastic proposal. He wants to help rebuild the hall, then tell everyone he knew your guild first.
entries.v: Bangsawan datang dengan pundi berat dan usulan penuh semangat. Ia ingin membantu membangun aula, lalu mengaku sebagai penggemar pertama kita.

entries.k: A pixel-art guild manager. Recruit heroes, send them on quests, forge legendary gear and rebuild the fallen Emberhall.
entries.v: Game pengelolaan guild dengan seni piksel. Rekrut pahlawan, kirim mereka bermisi, tempa gear legendaris, dan bangun kembali Emberhall.

entries.k: An adventurer trades a faded map for a seat by the fire. It promises sparkling ruins, hidden paths, and a very large X beside an old oak.
entries.v: Petualang menukar peta lusuh demi tempat dekat api. Ada reruntuhan berkilau, jalur rahasia, dan tanda X besar di samping pohon ek.

entries.k: An old training bell rings across the courtyard. Maren once learned here too. She offers her first lesson: a guild grows by helping each other improve.
entries.v: Lonceng latihan kembali berbunyi. Maren dahulu belajar di sini. Pelajaran pertamanya: guild tumbuh saat anggotanya saling membantu.

entries.k: At the fortieth landing, the lenses reveal the keeper's map: every road leads to a hearth. The Spire was built to connect people, and yours has answered.
entries.v: Di lantai empat puluh, lensa mengungkap peta penjaga: tiap jalan menuju tungku. Menara dibangun untuk menyatukan orang, dan guildmu telah menjawab.

entries.k: Bag → Gear → Auto equip. Then claim your reward.
entries.v: Tas → Gear → Pakai otomatis. Lalu ambil hadiahmu.

entries.k: Beyond Mushroom Grove, a waystone hums again. The shard fits its hollow. For the first time since the storm, villagers can follow a light home.
entries.v: Di balik Hutan Jamur, batu penunjuk berdengung lagi. Pecahan itu pas di rongganya. Sejak badai, warga akhirnya punya cahaya penuntun pulang.

entries.k: Board → Campaign → Slime Meadow. Select your party and fight.
entries.v: Papan → Kampanye → Padang Slime. Pilih tim dan bertarung.

entries.k: Bright ribbons and lanterns fill the village square. Your neighbors have saved a place at the feast for Emberhall. The whole guild is invited.
entries.v: Pita cerah dan lentera memenuhi alun-alun. Tetangga kita menyisakan tempat di pesta untuk Emberhall. Seluruh guild diundang.

entries.k: Build the Blacksmith in the Guild Hall.
entries.v: Bangun Pandai Besi di Aula Guild.

entries.k: Build the Blacksmith to enhance gear.
entries.v: Bangun Pandai Besi untuk menguatkan gear.

entries.k: Build the Infirmary so wounded heroes can recover.
entries.v: Bangun Rumah Sakit agar hero terluka bisa pulih.

entries.k: Choose a piece of gear to enhance. Higher enhancement raises its stats by {0}% per level.
entries.v: Pilih gear untuk dikuatkan. Setiap level menambah statistik sebesar {0}%.

entries.k: Choose at least one healthy hero from the list below.
entries.v: Pilih minimal satu pahlawan sehat dari daftar di bawah.

entries.k: Claim this chapter's reward to unlock your next step.
entries.v: Ambil hadiah bab ini untuk membuka langkah berikutnya.

entries.k: Claim this reward to unlock your next step.
entries.v: Ambil hadiah ini untuk membuka langkah berikutnya.

entries.k: Clear Gooey Hills, then Mushroom Grove. Heal between battles.
entries.v: Selesaikan Bukit Lengket, lalu Hutan Jamur. Pulihkan tim sebelum bertarung.

entries.k: Clear Mushroom Grove in Sunmeadow Plains.
entries.v: Selesaikan Hutan Jamur di Dataran Sunmeadow.

entries.k: Clear the next unlocked Campaign stage until Mushroom Grove opens.
entries.v: Selesaikan tahap Kampanye berikutnya hingga Hutan Jamur terbuka.

entries.k: Climb to floor 10 of the Endless Spire.
Come back in {0} for the next reward.
Conquer floor 40 of the Endless Spire.
Contracts are timed expeditions: send a party, close the app, and collect rewards later - even while offline.
entries.v: Kontrak adalah ekspedisi berwaktu: kirim tim, tutup aplikasi, ambil hadiah nanti - bahkan saat offline.

entries.k: Daily quests will appear after your first day.
entries.v: Misi harian muncul setelah hari pertamamu.

entries.k: Defeat the Black Magus in the Cinder Citadel.
entries.v: Kalahkan Penyihir Hitam di Benteng Cinder.

entries.k: Defeat the King Slime at the end of Sunmeadow Plains.
entries.v: Kalahkan Raja Slime di ujung Dataran Sunmeadow.

entries.k: Defeat the Lamia Queen in her lair.
Defeat the Minotaur Warlord in Gloomhold Crypt.
entries.v: Kalahkan Panglima Minotaur di Katakombe Gloomhold.

entries.k: Each floor is harder than the last. Rewards include rare gear, Arcane Essence and lots of Fame.
entries.v: Tiap lantai lebih sulit. Hadiah berupa gear langka, Esensi Arcane dan banyak Ketenaran.

entries.k: Each hero can occupy only one party slot. Remove the duplicate.
entries.v: Setiap pahlawan hanya boleh mengisi satu slot. Hapus pilihan ganda.

entries.k: Earn 100 Fame to become eligible for the Rank E exam.
entries.v: Raih 100 Ketenaran untuk ikut ujian Rank E.

entries.k: Earn {0} more Fame to unlock the Rank {1} exam.
entries.v: Raih {0} Ketenaran lagi untuk membuka ujian Rank {1}.

entries.k: Emberhall is nearly empty. Visit the Tavern and recruit a second hero.
entries.v: Emberhall hampir kosong. Kunjungi Kedai dan rekrut hero kedua.

entries.k: Farmers bring bread, letters, and news of your deeds. The council has noticed the reopened road. An invitation to the guild trials arrives at dawn.
entries.v: Petani membawa roti, surat, dan kabar jasa guildmu. Dewan melihat jalan yang terbuka. Undangan ujian guild tiba saat fajar.

entries.k: Finish or claim this hero's task before dismissing them.
entries.v: Selesaikan atau klaim tugas hero ini sebelum mengeluarkannya.

entries.k: Finish or claim this hero's task before promotion.
entries.v: Selesaikan atau klaim tugas hero ini sebelum promosi.

entries.k: Five beacons shine above a world brought together. Maren hangs her mother's map by the door. Below it, a new traveler asks if there is room for one more.
entries.v: Lima suar menerangi dunia yang kembali menyatu. Maren menggantung peta ibunya di pintu. Seorang pengelana baru bertanya apakah masih ada tempat.

entries.k: Five companions share a table once built for one. Their maps overlap, their stories differ, and their laughter makes the old hall feel like home.
entries.v: Lima sahabat duduk di meja yang dahulu untuk seorang. Peta mereka bertemu, kisah mereka berbeda, dan tawa membuat aula terasa seperti rumah.

entries.k: Focus wounded enemies. Keep full attack and defense.
entries.v: Fokus pada musuh terluka. Serangan dan pertahanan tetap utuh.

entries.k: Forge new gear, enhance items and salvage the rest.
entries.v: Tempa gear baru, perkuat item dan bongkar sisanya.

entries.k: Generates gold over time, even while you are away.
entries.v: Menghasilkan emas seiring waktu, bahkan saat kamu pergi.

entries.k: Gold accumulates even while the game is closed, up to the vault's capacity. Visit often!
entries.v: Emas terkumpul bahkan saat game ditutup, hingga kapasitas brankas. Sering-seringlah mampir!

entries.k: Heroes at their level cap can be promoted for more power.
entries.v: Hero di level maksimal bisa dipromosikan untuk lebih kuat.

entries.k: I'm building my guild in {0}! Recruit heroes, fight monsters and rise from Rank F to S. Join me: {1}
entries.v: Aku sedang membangun guild di {0}! Rekrut hero, lawan monster dan naik dari Rank F ke S. Gabung: {1}

entries.k: In Hall, tap the Tavern. Choose a candidate and press Hire. Claim this chapter from the quest tracker.
entries.v: Di Aula, ketuk Kedai. Pilih calon pahlawan, lalu tekan Rekrut. Ambil hadiah bab ini melalui pelacak misi.

entries.k: Keep at least one hero in your guild.
entries.v: Pertahankan setidaknya satu hero di guildmu.

entries.k: Letters arrive from every village you helped. The final ascent is ready. Your companions tuck the letters beside the five lenses and set out together.
entries.v: Surat tiba dari tiap desa yang dibantu. Pendakian terakhir siap. Para sahabat menyimpan surat bersama lima lensa, lalu berangkat bersama.

entries.k: Level {0} reached - needs a higher Guild Rank to go further
entries.v: Level {0} tercapai - butuh Rank Guild lebih tinggi untuk lanjut

entries.k: Log in every day for bigger rewards! Streak: {0}
entries.v: Login tiap hari untuk hadiah lebih besar! Beruntun: {0}

entries.k: Make room for a new hero
Maren sets a second cup by the hearth. The first companion has answered your banner; the Lantern Road begins with two people choosing to help.
entries.v: Maren menaruh cangkir kedua di tungku. Sahabat pertama menyambut panjimu; Jalan Lentera bermula dari dua orang yang memilih membantu.

entries.k: Maren: A guild can welcome all kinds of companions. Visit the Beast Den and invite a creature to adventure beneath our banner.
entries.v: Maren: Guild bisa menyambut beragam sahabat. Kunjungi Sarang Monster. Ajak satu makhluk bertualang di bawah panji kita.

entries.k: Maren: Blue lights dance between the trees. Explore Moonlit Glade. There are wonders in Whisperwood we have yet to discover.
entries.v: Maren: Cahaya biru menari di antara pepohonan. Jelajahi Moonlit Glade. Banyak keajaiban Whisperwood menunggu kita.

entries.k: Maren: Brannock's old anvil is waiting. Restore the Blacksmith, and fill our hall with the cheerful ring of hammers.
entries.v: Maren: Landasan tua Brannock menanti. Pulihkan Pandai Besi. Isi aula kita dengan denting palu yang riang.

entries.k: Maren: Courage brought them home. Good steel will do it again. Open the Bag and equip a hero before the next journey.
entries.v: Maren: Keberanian membawa mereka pulang. Baja yang baik akan menjaganya. Buka Tas dan pasang gear sebelum berangkat lagi.

entries.k: Maren: Even the bravest hero needs a soft bed sometimes. Build the Infirmary, and give everyone a warm place to recover.
entries.v: Maren: Pahlawan paling berani pun butuh ranjang nyaman. Bangun Rumah Sakit. Beri semuanya tempat hangat untuk pulih.

entries.k: Maren: Every trail ends at the Slime King's nest. Break its hold on Sunmeadow, and open the road for everyone behind us.
entries.v: Maren: Semua jejak menuju sarang Raja Slime. Bebaskan Sunmeadow dari cengkeramannya. Buka jalan bagi mereka yang mengikuti.

entries.k: Maren: Forty floors, a thousand wonders, and friends at every step. Carry our flame higher. The Spire has more stories to share.
entries.v: Maren: Empat puluh lantai, seribu keajaiban, dan teman di setiap langkah. Bawa nyala kita lebih tinggi. Menara masih penuh kisah.

entries.k: Maren: Good steel keeps a friend safe. Open Gear in the Bag and use Auto equip to prepare every hero for the next journey.
entries.v: Maren: Baja yang baik melindungi teman. Buka Gear di Tas dan gunakan Pakai otomatis untuk menyiapkan setiap pahlawan.

entries.k: Maren: Old training marks still line the courtyard. Build the Training Hall. Give our new heroes a place to grow.
entries.v: Maren: Bekas latihan masih terlihat di halaman. Bangun Aula Latihan. Beri pahlawan baru kita tempat untuk berkembang.

entries.k: Maren: Our banner flies farther than I ever dreamed. Earn Rank A. The next generation of adventurers is already cheering for us.
entries.v: Maren: Panji kita berkibar melampaui mimpiku. Raih Rank A. Generasi petualang berikutnya sudah bersorak untuk kita.

entries.k: Maren: Our travels have led us to Cinder Citadel. Reach Rank B, and prepare for the cleverest challenges we have faced yet.
entries.v: Maren: Perjalanan membawa kita ke Benteng Cinder. Raih Rank B. Siapkan diri untuk tantangan paling cerdik sejauh ini.

entries.k: Maren: Talent is a spark. Practice makes it a flame. Send a hero to train, then bring that strength to the next battle.
entries.v: Maren: Bakat hanyalah percikan. Latihan membuatnya menyala. Latih seorang pahlawan, lalu bawa kekuatannya ke pertempuran.

entries.k: Maren: The Association has sent its trial. Pass the Rank E exam, and our banner may cross into Whisperwood.
entries.v: Maren: Asosiasi telah mengirim ujian. Lulus ujian Rank E agar panji kita boleh memasuki Whisperwood.

entries.k: Maren: The Black Magus guards the Citadel's greatest marvels. Defeat him, and show what a guild of good friends can achieve.
entries.v: Maren: Penyihir Hitam menjaga keajaiban terbesar benteng. Kalahkan dia. Tunjukkan kekuatan guild yang penuh sahabat.

entries.k: Maren: The Lamia Queen guards a hidden forest trail. Challenge her in the lair, and find out where that winding path leads.
entries.v: Maren: Ratu Lamia menjaga jalur hutan tersembunyi. Tantang dia di sarangnya. Cari tahu ke mana jalan berliku itu mengarah.

entries.k: Maren: The Sand Tyrant has buried the caravan road. Bring it down. The desert's scattered settlements depend on that passage.
entries.v: Maren: Tiran Pasir mengubur jalan karavan. Kalahkan dia. Permukiman gurun bergantung pada jalur itu.

entries.k: Maren: The Spire shines above the clouds, just as the old tales promised. Climb ten floors. Bring home a story of your own.
entries.v: Maren: Menara berkilau di atas awan, seperti kisah lama. Panjat sepuluh lantai. Bawa pulang ceritamu sendiri.

entries.k: Maren: The Warlord guards a gate bearing the Spire's sigil. Challenge him in Gloomhold. An old guild secret may lie beyond.
entries.v: Maren: Panglima menjaga gerbang berlambang Menara. Tantang dia di Gloomhold. Rahasia guild lama mungkin menanti di seberang.

entries.k: Maren: The court has invited us to its next trial. Reach Rank C, and earn a pass to explore the ancient halls of Gloomhold.
entries.v: Maren: Istana mengundang kita ke ujian berikutnya. Raih Rank C agar kita boleh menjelajahi aula kuno Gloomhold.

entries.k: Maren: The farmers need a little help. Open Campaign on the Board and start Slime Meadow. Take your new teammate into battle.
entries.v: Maren: Para petani butuh bantuan. Buka Kampanye di Papan, lalu mulai Padang Slime. Ajak rekan barumu bertarung.

entries.k: Maren: The farmers need a little help. Take a contract from the Board, and show Sunmeadow what our new guild can do.
entries.v: Maren: Para petani butuh bantuan. Ambil kontrak di Papan Misi. Tunjukkan kemampuan guild baru kita kepada Sunmeadow.

entries.k: Maren: The grove feeds half the village. Clear the creatures from it, and our neighbors can harvest without fear.
entries.v: Maren: Hutan itu memberi makan separuh desa. Usir makhluk di sana agar tetangga kita bisa memanen tanpa takut.

entries.k: Maren: The hearth is lit, but a guild needs more than one brave soul. Visit the Tavern. Bring someone home.
entries.v: Maren: Tungku sudah menyala, tetapi satu pahlawan belum cukup. Kunjungi Kedai. Ajak seseorang pulang.

entries.k: Maren: There are empty chairs at our table. Welcome five heroes, and turn this shelter into a guild again.
entries.v: Maren: Masih ada kursi kosong di meja kita. Sambut lima pahlawan. Jadikan tempat berlindung ini sebuah guild lagi.

entries.k: Maren: Traders speak of glittering ruins beyond the dunes. Earn Rank D, and prepare our guild for a grand desert adventure.
entries.v: Maren: Pedagang berkabar tentang reruntuhan berkilau di gurun. Raih Rank D. Siapkan guild kita untuk petualangan besar.

entries.k: Maren: We began with one little spark. Reach Rank S, and make Emberhall a welcoming home for every adventure still to come.
entries.v: Maren: Kita bermula dari satu bara kecil. Capai Rank S. Jadikan Emberhall rumah hangat bagi setiap petualangan mendatang.

entries.k: Maren: We cannot restore a reputation with a name alone. Earn 100 Fame. Let our deeds speak before the Association.
entries.v: Maren: Nama saja tidak memulihkan kepercayaan. Raih 100 Ketenaran. Biarkan tindakan kita berbicara kepada Asosiasi.

entries.k: Max enhancement for your Blacksmith level ({0}). Upgrade the Blacksmith!
entries.v: Penguatan maksimal untuk level Pandai Besimu ({0}). Tingkatkan Pandai Besi!

entries.k: Maximum rank reached. You are a legend!
More beds for heroes, more room in your bag.
entries.v: Lebih banyak ranjang hero, lebih banyak ruang tas.

entries.k: No active expeditions. Pick a contract below!
entries.v: Tak ada ekspedisi aktif. Pilih kontrak di bawah!

entries.k: No compatible items in your bag. Defeat monsters or visit the Blacksmith!
entries.v: Tak ada item cocok di tas. Kalahkan monster atau kunjungi Pandai Besi!

entries.k: No heroes are ready. Open a hero and use a healing potion, or visit the Infirmary.
entries.v: Belum ada pahlawan siap. Buka seorang pahlawan dan pakai ramuan penyembuh, atau kunjungi Rumah Sakit.
Belum ada bahan atau barang habis pakai.

entries.k: No side quests available right now. Keep playing to unlock more!
entries.v: Belum ada misi sampingan. Terus bermain untuk membuka lebih banyak!

entries.k: No synergy - mix classes for bonuses!
entries.v: Tanpa sinergi - campur kelas untuk bonus!

entries.k: On Board > Campaign, clear Gooey Hills, then Mushroom Grove. Keep your party healthy between battles.
entries.v: Di Papan > Kampanye, selesaikan Bukit Berlendir, lalu Hutan Jamur. Pulihkan timmu di antara pertarungan.

entries.k: On the Spire's tenth landing, your four lights reveal a hidden stair. The fifth lens waits in Cinder Citadel. The keepers' message is nearly whole.
entries.v: Di lantai sepuluh Menara, empat cahaya mengungkap tangga rahasia. Lensa kelima menanti di Benteng Cinder. Pesan penjaga hampir utuh.

entries.k: Open Bag > Gear and tap Auto equip. Claim this chapter from the quest tracker when your heroes are equipped.
entries.v: Buka Tas > Gear, lalu ketuk Pakai otomatis. Ambil hadiah bab ini melalui pelacak misi setelah pahlawanmu siap.

entries.k: Open Bag → Gear and tap AUTO-EQUIP.
entries.v: Buka Tas → Gear lalu tekan PAKAI OTOMATIS.

entries.k: Open Bag → Gear. Tap AUTO-EQUIP to give each hero their best compatible items.
entries.v: Buka Tas → Gear. Ketuk PAKAI OTOMATIS agar setiap pahlawan memakai item terbaik yang sesuai.

entries.k: Open Board > Campaign > Sunmeadow Plains. Start Slime Meadow, select your heroes and press Fight.
entries.v: Buka Papan > Kampanye > Dataran Sunmeadow. Mulai Padang Slime, pilih pahlawan, lalu tekan Lawan!.

entries.k: Open Campaign on the Board. Start Slime Meadow, keep the selected heroes, then tap FIGHT.
entries.v: Buka Kampanye di Papan. Mulai Padang Slime, gunakan tim terpilih, lalu ketuk LAWAN!.

entries.k: Open Campaign, start Slime Meadow, and tap FIGHT.
entries.v: Buka Kampanye, mulai Padang Slime, lalu tekan BERTARUNG.

entries.k: Open the Quest Board, pick a mission and win your first battle.
entries.v: Buka Papan Misi, pilih misi dan menangkan pertarungan pertamamu.

entries.k: Open the Tavern. Hire one companion using your starting gold.
entries.v: Buka Kedai. Rekrut satu sahabat dengan emas awalmu.

entries.k: Open your Bag and equip an item on a hero.
entries.v: Buka Tas dan pasang item pada hero.

entries.k: Optional goals with big rewards. Completed: {0}/{1}
entries.v: Tujuan opsional dengan hadiah besar. Selesai: {0}/{1}

entries.k: Pass the Rank E exam from the Quest Board.
entries.v: Lulus ujian Rank E dari Papan Misi.

entries.k: Pass the final trial and reach Guild Rank S.
entries.v: Lulus ujian akhir dan capai Rank Guild S.

entries.k: Practice turns a hesitant recruit into a dependable companion. Your heroes mark the next route together. No one will have to walk it alone.
entries.v: Latihan mengubah rekrut yang ragu menjadi sahabat andalan. Para pahlawan menandai rute berikutnya bersama. Tak seorang pun berjalan sendiri.

entries.k: Promoting {0} raises all stats by {1}% and the level cap by {2}.
entries.v: Promosi {0} menaikkan semua statistik {1}% dan batas level {2}.

entries.k: Rank exam unlocked! Open the Quest Board.
entries.v: Ujian rank terbuka! Buka Papan Misi.

entries.k: Reach Rank E to tame monsters
entries.v: Capai Rank E untuk menjinakkan monster

entries.k: Recruit a hero at the Tavern.
Recruit heroes, send them on quests and rebuild the hall. Rise from Rank F to the legendary Rank S!
entries.v: Rekrut hero, kirim ke misi dan bangun kembali aula. Naik dari Rank F ke Rank S yang legendaris!

entries.k: Recruit new heroes and tame monsters. Higher levels improve candidate quality.
entries.v: Rekrut hero baru dan jinakkan monster. Level lebih tinggi meningkatkan kualitas calon.

entries.k: Scroll to the candidates. Tap HIRE + the gold price on an affordable hero.
entries.v: Gulir ke calon pahlawan. Ketuk REKRUT beserta harga emas yang mampu kamu bayar.

entries.k: Sell {0} Common & Uncommon items that nobody is wearing for {1} gold?
entries.v: Jual {0} item Biasa & Tak Biasa yang tak dipakai seharga {1} emas?

entries.k: Send a hero to train in the Training Hall.
entries.v: Kirim hero berlatih di Aula Latihan.

entries.k: Something is scratching behind the pantry door. The cook has counted six missing sacks and refuses to open it alone.
entries.v: Ada suara cakaran di balik pintu dapur. Enam karung sudah hilang. Juru masak menolak membuka pintunya sendirian.

entries.k: Spend gems to finish this right away.
Tame a monster at the Tavern's Beast Den.
entries.v: Jinakkan monster di Sarang Monster Kedai.

entries.k: Tame monsters with Soul Seals (dropped by bosses and contracts). Monsters are powerful and form a Beast Pack together!
entries.v: Jinakkan monster dengan Segel Jiwa (dari bos dan kontrak). Monster itu kuat dan membentuk Kawanan Buas bersama!

entries.k: Tap HIRE on an affordable candidate, then claim your guide reward.
entries.v: Tekan REKRUT pada calon yang terjangkau, lalu ambil hadiah panduan.

entries.k: Tap Hire. You already have enough gold.
Tap SKIP to finish the battle

entries.v: Ketuk untuk ambil hadiah hari ini!

entries.k: Tavern → Hire one companion. Then claim your reward.
entries.v: Kedai → Rekrut satu sahabat. Lalu ambil hadiahmu.

entries.k: The Black Magus relinquishes the last lens. Five colors cross the sky above the Citadel. Far away, Emberhall's hearth answers with a golden flame.
entries.v: Penyihir Hitam menyerahkan lensa terakhir. Lima warna membentang di atas Benteng. Jauh di sana, tungku Emberhall membalas dengan nyala emas.

entries.k: The King Slime releases an amber lens from its crown. Sunmeadow's beacon blooms gold. Across the valley, a distant tower answers with a single flash.
entries.v: Raja Slime melepaskan lensa kuning dari mahkotanya. Suar Sunmeadow bersinar emas. Menara jauh di lembah membalas dengan satu kilatan.

entries.k: The Lamia Queen yields the forest lens to those who have earned her respect. Whisperwood glows blue; two restored beacons now trace a path south.
entries.v: Ratu Lamia menyerahkan lensa hutan kepada tim yang dihormatinya. Whisperwood berkilau biru; dua suar kini menunjukkan jalan ke selatan.

entries.k: The Sand Tyrant falls and the buried beacon rises. Its lens shines rose-gold. Caravans sound their bells as three valleys reconnect at last.
entries.v: Tiran Pasir tumbang dan suar terkubur muncul. Lensanya bersinar emas merah. Lonceng karavan berbunyi saat tiga lembah akhirnya tersambung.

entries.k: The Warlord's vault holds a violet lens and a keeper's letter. Maren reads her mother's handwriting: 'Let every lost traveler find a welcome.'
entries.v: Brankas Panglima menyimpan lensa ungu dan surat penjaga. Maren mengenali tulisan ibunya: 'Sambut setiap pengelana yang tersesat.'

entries.k: The council entrusts your guild with the caravan roads. Beyond the dunes lies a third beacon, buried beneath the route the storm erased.
entries.v: Dewan mempercayakan jalan karavan kepada guildmu. Di balik bukit pasir, suar ketiga terkubur di jalur yang dihapus badai.

entries.k: The council names Emberhall a guardian of the roads. Maren finally tells the guild why she stayed: her mother believed someone would return to finish the lights.
entries.v: Dewan menamai Emberhall penjaga jalan. Maren akhirnya bercerita: ibunya percaya seseorang akan kembali menuntaskan cahaya-cahaya itu.

entries.k: The courier leaves a bundle of rescued gear at your door. Maren polishes the amber shard. It glows whenever the party gathers around the hearth.
entries.v: Kurir meninggalkan perlengkapan yang diselamatkan. Maren memoles pecahan kuning. Cahayanya menyala setiap tim berkumpul di tungku.

entries.k: The infirmary opens with fresh linen and flowers. Maren places a lamp by every bed. Bringing everyone home matters more than arriving first.
entries.v: Rumah sakit dibuka dengan seprai bersih dan bunga. Maren menaruh lampu di setiap ranjang. Pulang bersama lebih penting daripada tiba pertama.

entries.k: The item will be destroyed for materials.
The main story is complete. Keep climbing the Spire!
entries.v: Cerita utama tamat. Terus panjat Menara!

entries.k: The meadow courier reaches home at last. In the slime's trail, your heroes find a shard of amber glass: the first clue to the missing beacons.
entries.v: Kurir padang rumput akhirnya pulang. Dalam jejak slime, tim menemukan pecahan kaca kuning: petunjuk pertama tentang suar yang hilang.

entries.k: The merchant restocks every day. Gear quality is random!
entries.v: Pedagang menambah stok tiap hari. Kualitas gear acak!

entries.k: They will leave the guild forever. Equipped gear returns to your bag.
entries.v: Mereka akan meninggalkan guild selamanya. Gear terpasang kembali ke tas.

entries.k: This battle is unavailable. Return to Board > Campaign and choose an unlocked mission.
entries.v: Pertarungan ini tidak tersedia. Kembali ke Papan > Kampanye dan pilih misi yang terbuka.

entries.k: This contract has expired. Return to Board > Contracts and choose a current offer.
entries.v: Kontrak ini kedaluwarsa. Kembali ke Papan > Kontrak dan pilih penawaran terbaru.

entries.k: This deletes your guild, heroes and items. This cannot be undone.
entries.v: Ini menghapus guild, hero dan itemmu. Tidak dapat dibatalkan.

entries.k: This hero is no longer in your guild. Choose another hero.
entries.v: Pahlawan ini sudah meninggalkan guild. Pilih pahlawan lain.

entries.k: This hero is on an expedition. Claim the return in Board > Contracts, or choose another hero.
entries.v: Pahlawan ini sedang berekspedisi. Ambil hasilnya di Papan > Kontrak, atau pilih pahlawan lain.

entries.k: This hero is training or healing. Wait for the task to finish, or choose another hero.
entries.v: Pahlawan ini sedang berlatih atau dirawat. Tunggu hingga selesai, atau pilih pahlawan lain.

entries.k: This hero needs recovery. Use a potion in Heroes, heal at the Infirmary, or choose another hero.
entries.v: Pahlawan ini perlu pulih. Pakai ramuan di Hero, rawat di Rumah Sakit, atau pilih pahlawan lain.

entries.k: This mission is locked. Clear the previous stage or raise your Guild Rank on the Board.
entries.v: Misi ini terkunci. Selesaikan tahap sebelumnya atau naikkan Rank Guild melalui Papan.

entries.k: This will erase your current guild forever.
entries.v: Ini akan menghapus gildamu saat ini selamanya.

entries.k: Train heroes over time and raise the hero level cap.
entries.v: Latih hero seiring waktu dan naikkan batas level hero.

entries.k: Training grants a full level of XP and works while you are away.
entries.v: Latihan memberi XP satu level penuh dan berjalan saat kamu pergi.

entries.k: Two tired adventurers turn a disputed contract into a flying chair. The whole Tavern is waiting to see how its Guildmaster responds.
entries.v: Dua petualang lelah memperdebatkan kontrak hingga kursi terbang. Seisi Kedai menunggu keputusan pemimpin guild.

entries.k: Under silver leaves, your party follows a trail of blue sparks. A forest keeper has hidden the second lens beyond the glade, safe from the storm.
entries.v: Di bawah daun perak, tim mengikuti percikan biru. Penjaga hutan menyimpan lensa kedua di balik lembah, terlindung dari badai.

entries.k: Unlocks research that permanently strengthens your guild.
entries.v: Membuka riset yang memperkuat guildmu secara permanen.

entries.k: Upgrade the Barracks to make room for another hero.
entries.v: Tingkatkan Barak untuk menampung pahlawan baru.

entries.k: Use a healing potion, or recover at the Infirmary.
entries.v: Gunakan ramuan penyembuh, atau pulihkan diri di Rumah Sakit.

entries.k: Wounded heroes heal here much faster than resting. Potions work instantly.
entries.v: Hero terluka sembuh jauh lebih cepat di sini. Ramuan bekerja seketika.

entries.k: You already have one hero and starting gold. Open the Tavern and hire one more.
entries.v: Kamu punya satu pahlawan dan modal emas. Buka Kedai, lalu rekrut satu lagi.

entries.k: You can be promoted! Tap your rank.
entries.v: Kamu bisa naik rank! Ketuk rankmu.

entries.k: You completed the main story! Legend of Emberhall!
entries.v: Kamu menamatkan cerita utama! Legenda Emberhall!

entries.k: You search until dusk. Her family thanks you for trying and offers a small reward.
entries.v: Kamu mencari hingga senja. Keluarganya berterima kasih atas usahamu dan memberi hadiah kecil.

entries.k: Your bag is empty. Win battles to find gear!
entries.v: Tasmu kosong. Menangkan pertarungan untuk dapat gear!

entries.k: Your banner now flies at every caravan stop. An archivist sends a rubbing from Gloomhold: the five lenses form a map, not a weapon.
entries.v: Panjimu berkibar di tiap perhentian karavan. Arsiparis mengirim prasasti Gloomhold: lima lensa membentuk peta, bukan senjata.

entries.k: Your heroes need rest or healing first
entries.v: Heromu perlu istirahat atau disembuhkan dulu

entries.k: Your heroes were hurt. Visit the Infirmary!
Your new seal grants passage into Whisperwood. Maren recognizes the flash from the tower: the old keepers are asking Emberhall to finish their work.
entries.v: Segel baru membuka jalan ke Whisperwood. Maren mengenali kilatan Menara: penjaga lama meminta Emberhall menuntaskan pekerjaan mereka.

entries.k: Your party is full. Remove a hero before adding another.
entries.v: Tim sudah penuh. Keluarkan satu pahlawan sebelum menambahkan yang lain.

entries.k: Your party was defeated. Train, upgrade gear, or bring a healer and try again!
entries.v: Timmu kalah. Latih, tingkatkan gear, atau bawa penyembuh lalu coba lagi!

entries.k: Your roster is full. Upgrade the Barracks, then return to recruit.
entries.v: Daftar pahlawan sudah penuh. Tingkatkan Barak, lalu kembali untuk merekrut.

entries.k: Your smith studies the broken lens mount. This was no ordinary lantern: five lenses once carried a message between the valleys and the Spire.
entries.v: Pandai besimu memeriksa dudukan lensa. Ini bukan lentera biasa: lima lensa dahulu membawa pesan antara lembah dan Menara.
